# State Provider demo stages companion twice on overlapping clicks

## Context

Promotes `@neo-gpt-euclid`'s post-merge `defect-note` (`MESSAGE:7e9f6149-293a-43f7-9f9d-793aba38f312`) observed on `examples/stateProvider/advanced/MainContainerController.mjs` after `#22028` (`#21879`, under Epic #21358) landed on `dev`.

- Live latest-open + closed sweep: checked latest 25 open (49 open, orange band; `#22050`..`#21346`, folding under Epic #21358) + open and closed search (`stateProvider companion onOpenSecondWindowClick`, `stateProvider advanced companion`, `#21879` `Out of Scope` / `Avoided Traps` read) at `2026-11-23T01:11:07Z`; no equivalent or prior exclusion found.
- A2A in-flight claim sweep: checked latest 30 messages across all read states (`2026-11-23T00:37Z`–`01:11Z`); no overlapping `[lane-claim]` or `[lane-intent]`.
- MC sweep: `onOpenSecondWindowClick openingCompanion isWindowOpen overlapping companion launch`, 5 results, no prior decision found.
- Own-assignment sweep: 2 open (`#22046` with PR `#22048` in review, `#21847` post-cut live verification), none overlapping.
- Ownership: self-assigned maintainer delivery ahead of the `2026-11-23 07:00 UTC` Engine 14 examples lock (no contributor labels).

## The Problem

In `MainContainerController#onOpenSecondWindowClick()` (`examples/stateProvider/advanced/MainContainerController.mjs:176-217`), the `#openingCompanion` reentrancy flag is set at line `195` **after** `await CompanionSurface.isWindowOpen(windowId)` (`line 182`).

When a visitor double-clicks **Open Second Window** (or triggers two overlapping invocations before the worker-to-main `CompanionSurface.isWindowOpen` RPC settles):
1. Both calls pass `if (me.isDestroyed || me.#openingCompanion) return;` while `#openingCompanion` is still `false`.
2. Both calls suspend at `await CompanionSurface.isWindowOpen(windowId)` and receive `false`.
3. Both calls enter the `openWindow` path and invoke `CompanionSurface.openWindow(me.component)` -> `Neo.Main.windowOpen`. Because `Neo.Main.windowOpen` (`src/Main.mjs:1366-1408`) reuses `targetName`, calls `#invalidateNativeWindowEntry(existingWin)`, and mints a fresh one-time `#pendingWindowRoutes` token, the second overlapping launch invalidates the first launch's staged route and re-stages the companion popup.

## The Architectural Reality

- Design authority: `"Focuses an existing companion window in place via Neo.Main.windowFocus, or opens a new one bound to this view's StateProvider."` (`examples/stateProvider/advanced/MainContainerController.mjs:173`) and `@type {Boolean} #openingCompanion = false` (`MainContainerController.mjs:33`, `"Prevents duplicate windowOpen calls while an async launch is already in flight"`).
- `examples/stateProvider/advanced/MainContainerController.mjs:176-217`: `onOpenSecondWindowClick()` performs an async main-thread liveness check (`CompanionSurface.isWindowOpen(windowId)`) whenever `hasLiveCompanion()` has not yet observed a connected companion app in `Neo.apps`.
- `src/Main.mjs:1366-1408`: `Neo.Main.windowOpen` invalidates any prior `openWindows[windowName]` entry and replaces its one-time `#pendingWindowRoutes` token when called a second time for the same `windowName`.

## The Fix

Acquire `me.#openingCompanion = true` immediately after `if (me.isDestroyed || me.#openingCompanion) return;` at entry to `MainContainerController#onOpenSecondWindowClick()`, wrapping both the `hasLiveCompanion() || await CompanionSurface.isWindowOpen(windowId)` focus branch and the `CompanionSurface.openWindow(me.component)` launch branch inside a single `try { ... } finally { me.#openingCompanion = false }` block.

## Decision Record impact

`none` — localized controller reentrancy guard in `examples/stateProvider/advanced`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Two overlapping `onOpenSecondWindowClick()` calls invoked while `CompanionSurface.isWindowOpen()` is pending dispatch `CompanionSurface.openWindow()` / `Neo.Main.windowOpen` at most once and zero `windowFocus` calls when the probe resolves `false`.
- [ ] Two overlapping `onOpenSecondWindowClick()` calls invoked while `CompanionSurface.isWindowOpen()` is pending dispatch `CompanionSurface.focusWindow()` / `Neo.Main.windowFocus` at most once and zero `windowOpen` calls when the probe resolves `true`, and `#openingCompanion` resets in `finally` (including after focus or rejection) so a subsequent settled click still executes.
- [ ] Deterministic unit regression coverage in `test/playwright/unit/examples/stateProvider/AdvancedSurfaces.spec.mjs` fails against unpatched `dev` (`openCalls.length === 2`) and passes with the fix (`openCalls.length === 1`).

## Out of Scope

- Modifying `src/Main.mjs#windowOpen` or `CompanionSurface.mjs` RPC contracts.
- Retaking `state-provider-14` catalog covers (zero visual or DOM change).

## Avoided Traps

- **Setting `#openingCompanion = true` only around `openWindow()`:** Leaves the `await CompanionSurface.isWindowOpen(windowId)` suspension window unguarded, which is the exact race reported in `MESSAGE:7e9f6149-293a-43f7-9f9d-793aba38f312`.
- **Early-returning from the `focusWindow()` branch outside `try/finally`:** Would leave `#openingCompanion = true` permanently wedged after focusing an already-open popup.
